fusions.name: Tongue Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out a barbed tongue at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung from the Reeds
fusions.desc: You spring onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and burst spines out where you land, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 50% chance of being [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Legs
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds.
